en.headline: Government proposes up to one year of paid sick leave for injured platform delivery…
en.dek: The Digital Platform Workers Compensation Bill sets a three-tier system based on working hours, with platforms required to carry insurance for food and goods delivery staff.
body: The Labour and Welfare Bureau has tabled details of the Digital Platform Workers Compensation Bill to the Legislative Council, proposing a three-tier system of paid sick leave for food and goods delivery workers injured on the job.

Under the scheme, workers with fewer than 230 hours in the preceding 90 days would be eligible for up to three months of periodical payments, those with 230 to 385 hours up to six months, and those exceeding 385 hours up to 12 months. Platforms would be required to take out insurance covering work-related injuries and deaths.
Authorities said the mechanism aims to provide clearer protection while considering the affordability of platform operators. The bill is expected to receive its first reading next month.

Other compensation items, including medical expenses, permanent incapacity payments and death benefits, would follow principles similar to those under the Employees’ Compensation Ordinance, regardless of the tier.

zh.headline: 政府擬為平台外送員工傷設三級制 最高可獲一年有薪病假
zh.dek: 《數碼平台工作者補償條例草案》按工時劃分三級，食物及貨物外送平台須購買保險，保障工傷及死亡個案。
body: 勞工及福利局向立法會提交《數碼平台工作者補償條例草案》細節，建議為食物及貨物外送平台工作者設立三級工傷病假錢制度。
根據建議，過去90日工時少於230小時者最多可獲3個月按期付款，230至385小時者最多6個月，超過385小時者最多12個月。平台營運商須購買涵蓋工傷及死亡的保險。
當局表示，機制旨在為平台工作者提供更清晰保障，同時考慮營運商的承擔能力。條例草案預計下月進行首讀。
醫療費用、永久喪失工作能力補償及死亡補償等其他項目，不論級別，原則上將參考《僱員補償條例》的相關規定。
